about: Representative raw outputs of the attribution lab (round 2). Gold files are synthetic dialogues (no real people). expect.json rows come from the lab's reference validators (V1b percent-aware numbers + V2 question detection + V3 transcript-derived names, fragment-wise quote guard with anchor agreement) and the hybrid policy; they are what a conforming implementation should reproduce, except where a row says otherwise. hand_adjudication marks points read by hand.

fixtures.why: The shipped prompt (no quote, no enum): five points whose text carries a name or title the transcript uses to address people (署長, 部長, 里長 ...) and similar wording leaks. The committed validators keep them (attribution of every one is right); the transcript-derived name check (V3) must drop them. Also the number-format problem: digits vs Chinese numerals.

The production retry loop: call_first.json is attempt 1 (rejected, more than 25% dropped); call.json is attempt 2 whose user message carries the rejection hint between the range lines and the transcript. Pins the hint format and shows the second attempt being accepted (8 of 10 kept). Debate: two speakers who restate each other's figures (echo traps).

A mostly clean P4 output (caller, host, a minor voice tagged X): 15 of 16 points survive the recommended pipeline; the minor/undecidable turns are never cited (enum). The one drop is a computed figure: T30 says the budget was 三億兩千萬 and 實際執行 一億二千萬 and the point states 預算執行率僅約六成 (a ratio the speaker never said, and wrong): number check, no rescue.

A stitched quote that joins the end of one turn with the start of the next (貨車可以夜間配送。對，晚上十點到早上六點配送): the fragment-wise quote guard must drop it (no single turn holds every fragment). Echo turns (a speaker restating the other side's figure) must not be re-anchored.

Hybrid policy: points whose paraphrase fails only the lexical support check are shown as the verified verbatim quote; BUT T30 is the legislator restating the official's logic and asking for confirmation (...所以十個標案發出去就算達成，土方有沒有清根本不重要，是這個意思嗎？): quoting the declarative part alone would invert the stance, so that quote must NOT be rescued.

Fresh-sample call (seed 3001). T23 (S4) says 旅行時間可以減少百分之十二; the point says 可縮短十二分鐘車程 (percent became minutes). Attribution is right, the committed validators and V1 (bare value 12 == 12) keep it, the percent-aware number check V1b drops it. Also holds a 'question stated as fact' false positive and several ordinary kept points.

ASR-noisy meeting with mixed numeral formats (3/11, 570, 95, 六個), nicknames used as vocatives (阿凱, 小安) and turns that restate someone's problem. Two points are flagged by the key-based scorer ('hallucinated' T12, 'merged' T41) and are false positives (hand read): expect them kept.

Fresh-sample call (seed 3001). Page 1 point 3 (統計六千三百二十位學生食用，十七位通報不適) has its quote in T0 (the spokesman, S1) but the committed validators re-anchor it to T2 (a reporter, S2, who repeats the figures in a question) and KEEP it: a wrong-speaker point (hand-confirmed). Anchor agreement with the quote's turn drops it (anchor_conflict). Page 2 point 1: the model cited T8 (the reporter's question) but the words are the spokesman's answer in T9: re-anchored to T9 (legitimate, cross-speaker) and shown as the verified verbatim quote (rescued).

Fresh-sample call (seed 3001; the only call of 36 with 6 slides, fit_to_range cuts the sixth). T61: 使用率只有55% -> 使用率僅五十五成; T68: 涵蓋率現在是百分之九十一 -> 涵蓋率九十一成. V1 (bare value) keeps both, the committed check drops them by accident (literal 五十五), V1b drops them for the right reason. Also pins number formats that must be ACCEPTED: 兩百一十 / 二百一十, 1100萬 / 一千一百萬, 30元 / 三十元, 三萬九.

gemma4:latest ignores 'three to four points per slide': one slide with 39 points (the product shows at most MAX_BULLETS = 4 per slide, so the rest are validated but never displayed). Pins the need to cap or re-ask, and shows gemma4's output shape.
